title: Tropical Pineapple Tostada
description: A twist on traditional Mexican street food, this tostada combines the sweetness of pineapple with spicy tartness.
instructions: 1. Toast tortilla chips in the oven at 350°F (175°C) for 5 minutes, or until crispy.
2. In a separate pan, heat the tart over low heat.
3. In a bowl, combine diced pineapple, avocado, and chopped cilantro.
4. Assemble the tostada by placing toasted tortilla chips on a plate, topping with the pineapple-avocado mixture, and drizzling with sour cream, lime juice, and heated tart.
7. Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
